serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy…{{wi}} just snorted something…
Big Daddy: Oh, where are my manners? Please help yourself, there are a few lines already on da table.
You: Uh… {{wi}}Maybe later.
Big Daddy: Come on! Don’t be shy! I have a lot more somewhere in da kitchen. Helga always puts it away somewhere so I can’t find it. Ah, so annoying!
Big Daddy: People these days are awful! They think that only because they are getting paid da minimum wage they can slack off.
You: Yeah…
Big Daddy: Sorry about that. I didn’t mean to say awful things about Helga. She’s doing a good job. This white stuff is making me sometimes twitchy, so just ignore it, ok?
You: No problem, it’s fine!
I don’t really want to provoke a 7 foot tall black man on drugs…{{wi}} Seems like a bad idea.
